print("=== full digest+ligation simulation ===")
FLANK='tgcatc'; N='a'
def bsai_digest(top):
    # find GGTCTC on top -> left/right; return list of internal fragment as dict with left_ov, core_top, right_ov
    # we only need the internal fragment between two sites (one forward-oriented site upstream, one on bottom strand downstream)
    import re
    # top-strand site GGTCTC: cut top after +1, bottom after +5 -> overhang = top[i+7:i+11]? 
    # positions: GGTCTC at index i (len6). top cut between i+6+1 and rest: overhang = top[i+7:i+11]
    tops=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('ggtctc',top)]
    bots=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('gagacc',top)]  # bottom-strand ggtctc appears as gagacc on top
    assert len(tops)==1 and len(bots)==1, (tops,bots)
    i=tops[0]; j=bots[0]
    left_cut_top=i+7          # top strand retained from here
    left_ov=top[i+7:i+11]
    # right: gagacc at j; bottom strand ggtctc, cut leaves top strand retained up to j-1, overhang top[j-5:j-1] on top? 
    # For bottom site: top strand cut at position j-1 (5 nt to left), bottom cut at j-5. Overhang(5') is on bottom = top[j-5:j-1] region complement.
    core_top=top[i+7:j-1]
    right_ov=top[j-5:j-1]      # this is top-strand seq at right; bottom overhang = rc(right_ov)
    return left_ov, core_top, right_ov

frags2={}
downstream={'input':'egfp','egfp':'flag','flag':'snap','snap':'input'}
picks={'input':(19,36),'egfp':(19,21),'flag':(19,24),'snap':(23,21)}
digested={}
for f in order:
    C=frags[f]; Lf,Lr=picks[f]
    d4=frags[downstream[f]][:4]
    ADDf=FLANK+'ggtctc'+N
    ADDr=FLANK+'ggtctc'+N+rc(d4)
    product_top=ADDf+C+rc(ADDr)
    lo,core,ro=bsai_digest(product_top)
    # full assembled top for this fragment = lo? left_ov is 5' overhang of top strand = C[:4]; core=C[4:...]; 
    assembled_top=lo+core  # = C[:4]+C[4:len-? ] check
    digested[f]=(lo,core,ro,assembled_top)
    print(f,"leftov",lo,"rightov",ro,"assembled==C?",assembled_top==C[:len(assembled_top)], "core matches", C[4:].startswith(core[:5]))

# chain assembly: each fragment top = leftov+core ; junction rightov(top) equals next leftov

    nxt=order[(k+1)%4]
    if ro!=digested[nxt][0]:

    # fragment contributes leftov+core (top strand up to but not including its right overhang, which belongs to next)
    recon2+=lo+core

def bsai_frag(top):
    import re
    i=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('ggtctc',top)]
    j=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('gagacc',top)]
    assert len(i)==1 and len(j)==1
    i=i[0]; j=j[0]

# pair diffs
